input.customer_message:
Dear @115890, @MicrosoftHelps,

It doesn't help that THERE ARE NO ERROR CODES. This will be the FIFTH time I've had to reinstall Windows because of some bullshit OS error.

Who thought it was a good idea to omit error codes? Hope they don't work with you anymore. https://t.co/43XIp8dLfn
input.conversation_context:
MICROSOFT (468075): @226460 Let's work on this together. Please follow the steps in this article if you wish to start fresh with a clean installation of Windows 10: https://t.co/EMe3hnr4V1. Give us an update when you're done.
CUSTOMER (468076): @MicrosoftHelps No. No new software or hardware was installed. The error only occurred when my device was connected to the internet.
It's running Windows 10 Education v 1709, Build 16299.15

Ryzen 3 1200, no overclocks to CPU or Memory.
MSE is the only AV
Automatic Updates is enabled
MICROSOFT (468077): @226460 Let's investigate this further. Are you still experiencing the same issue after reinstalling Windows? Which Windows version are you using? Were there changes made to your device prior to this issue? Please tell us more.
CUSTOMER (468078): @MicrosoftHelps I could not identify the issue, and Safe Mode had the same error. I ended up just reinstalling Windows. Again.
First issue was I couldn't log in period.

There was no support forum, and none to report to with an error code :/
MICROSOFT (468079): @226460 Hi there, Winston. Is there anything that we can help? Please tell us more about the issue to assist you further. Thank you.
CUSTOMER (468080): @115890 @MicrosoftHelps Thanks again Microsoft. What a waste of time. https://t.co/4zl6caCf93
input.generated_reply: We understand how frustrating it is to repeatedly reinstall Windows without error codes to help troubleshoot. Because this issue requires further investigation into your specific OS error and system setup, please contact Microsoft Support so we can look into what might be causing these recurring issues.
